name: Guaza de Campos (Spain)
description: Square blue flag with a white triangle with its base along the upper edge and its apex at the middle of the lower edge, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Guaza de Campos (a church on blue and a cross of Saint James on white).
history: Municipal flag of Guaza de Campos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its vertices at the upper corners and the middle of the lower edge
